milestones.name: Setup Core Infrastructure and Environment
risks: Raspberry Pi 4 setup and performance profiling may reveal unexpected constraints
spikes: Performance testing with small dataset on Raspberry Pi 4 to validate target latency

milestones.name: Implement Document Storage and CRUD Operations
risks: SQLite performance under concurrent writes may impact throughput targets
spikes: Test SQLite performance with concurrent document operations under load simulation

milestones.name: Setup Hybrid Retrieval System (Dense + Sparse)
risks: Integration of LanceDB and BM25 may require custom fusion logic for optimal results
spikes: Evaluate and implement RRF fusion algorithm for combining dense and sparse scores

milestones.name: Add Session Management for Multi-turn Conversations
risks: Session cache performance may not meet 95% hit rate target under load
spikes: Implement and test session TTL and cache eviction strategies

milestones.name: Implement Admin Features (Tracing, Analytics, Logging)
risks: JWT validation complexity may introduce security vulnerabilities if not properly implemented
spikes: Implement and test Cloudflare Access JWT validation with proper error handling

milestones.name: Integration Testing and Performance Tuning
risks: Overall system performance may not meet P95 latency target of 2000ms
spikes: Full end-to-end performance testing with simulated user load

milestones.name: Final Optimization and Documentation
risks: Final performance tuning may introduce regressions in other components
spikes: Comprehensive testing of all documented edge cases and error conditions

migration_plan: No migration required as this is a new implementation of the personal knowledge RAG system.
